as_told.title: Anonymous Navy scientist on extended electrodynamics in Townsend Brown episode

plain: Jesse Michels says a top Navy scientist told him about extended electrodynamics, a broader version of the theory of electricity and magnetism that the scientist ties to the physicists James Clerk Maxwell and Oliver Heaviside. Michels says he interviewed this man for his film on an inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown, which he calls 'The Man Who Built UFOs for the CIA', and that the scientist stayed anonymous for fear of reprisals from his superiors. Michels brings it up in several episodes as a possible physics behind unexplained craft, calling the man a scientist in one and a whistleblower in another.
